notes.title: Version 2.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello Matchmakers!  

We've fixed a few critical bugs in the latest update, and added a new research ability (Oren finally has one, and it is quite good!)

On top of that, some of the earlier boss attacks were nerfed so they couldn't tank quite as much damage.

In sadder news, the game has not performed as well as we had hoped, so future updates are going to be limited in scope, and infrequent. That said, I still have a lot I want to add to the game, so when I have some free time I'll be sure to add in things when I can.

Patch notes below, happy matchmaking - Haydon, Ghost Moth  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44560074/a1a0d5951a9fcef5ddcc0f653e7ac1891974a29a.png"]

(Oren finally found some inspiration in the Library!)
Version 2.0.4 Patch notes
Added:

Oren has a tag-in research, which allows you to change assist mid combat!

Changes:

Calyx will prevent the player from using the healing activity at full health

The relationship book and inventory will pulse when something new is added to them

There is now a warning on the training activity if you have 1 HP.

 Bug fixes:

Calyx will no longer prevent the player from healing when they need to

Healing dialogue no longer gets stuck on screen

Fixed end of a few dates as mentioned by steam bug reports

Various Typo Fixes

notes.title: Version 2.0.1 and what comes next
notes.notes:
Hello Matchmakers!  

We've put out a bug fix patch to clean up some of the late game bugs we've come across (Thanks again for the bug reports!) Patch notes for that can be found below.

For future updates, there are a lot of things we'd like to add to the game that aren't present, but to afford that, we're going to need people to find the game, buy it, and give it a positive steam review. We're doing what we can on our end to promote Dungeon Heart as much as we can, but anything you can do on your end is greatly appreciated.

Future content we'd like to add includes:

Steam Achievements

Character Costumes

Auto text, text log and skip text

Unlocking all the remaining researches

Dungeon activity for Razza and a proper one for Jett

VFX for all the spells

More food recipes

More save slots

Platonic versions of dates 3 and 4

Befriending/Fighting the Lich

A lot of this does have some groundwork completed, so hopefully we can get the results we need to make it happen. If there's something on this list you absolutely need, tag us in a socials post or reply to this post letting us know what we should focus on.

If you're interested in helping us promote the game in some way, by streaming, speedrunning, writing about or making videos about Dungeon Heart, reach out to us at ghostmothhq@gmail.com, we'd love to hear what ideas you have.

Happy gaming -Ghost Moth  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44560074/daca16a90238389b1d5b7d996b4f020f73d3a278.png"]

(Moosifer chilling deep underwater)
Version 2.0.1 Patch notes
Added:

New music and dialogue calls for end of the game invasion  

 Changes: 

Nerfed Commander Daybreak's highest damage attacks

Increased attack effectiveness for ??? 

Decreased length of ??? Phase 2

SFX, voice and music volume levelling 

Character icons now disappear on the map for day 29 


Bug fixes:

Final day combat no longer has immediate invincibility or soft lock issues 

Fixed bug that conflicted with some research abilities making puzzles soft lock 

Calyx's Shadow Bats power works correctly 

Block breaking attacks now work as intended (Sorry Philomela) 

Curse of Greed attack no longer causes soft locks  

Fixed several dialogue boxes persisting over match 3 games and preventing play

If you encounter puzzles that are locking up still, please post a screenshot in the bug report forum post. These are proving to be very situational and it's quite the challenge finding them all.

notes.title: Full release Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello Matchmakers!

We did it! With today's major update you can now play through the entirety of Matchmaker Dungeon Heart! 

We've been working super hard to get this done in time, so we hope you enjoy the new content and the thrilling conclusion to the story.

Here is all the new stuff you'll find in the game:

The Ending! You can beat the game!

New voice acting! Calyx, The Lich, Gnerrin and the bosses!

New activities: Cooking and Ordering a drink!

New Hangouts and Dates!

New researches from Calyx and Jett!

So much new content. And on top of that, we've got two lovely streamers who will be showcasing the game today! Feel free to check out FieryAshes and Rowan as they discover some fun recipes that were inspired by their communities.

We'll make another post in a few days for what comes next with Dungeon Heart, we'll be supporting the game for the near future and we still have quite a bit we want to include into the game (including achievements, costumes, dungeon activities and more).

As a final note, we will be raising the price of the game to reflect its now massive amount of content, but we can't do that until the current sale ends, so NOW IS TRULY THE LAST CHANCE TO GET THE WHOLE GAME AT A GREAT PRICE.

So please, tell a friend, leave a review, and help us reach our audience! We want to make this game perfect, and for that to happen, we need the best launch possible.

Patch notes below as well as a bit of a sneak peek for future content, thanks for reading! - Ghost Moth

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44560074/c93a6813893b00dadb11b13bb2a49676e1e39604.png"]


Version 2.0 Patch notes
Added: 

You can now beat the final boss and win the game!

Added additional voice acting for datable characters, with new voices for Calyx, The Lich, Gnerrin and all of the bosses!!!

All characters now have 2 hangouts and 2 romantic dates, and can have their relationship maxed out.

New dungeon activities: Cooking and Order a Drink 

Can collect recipes for cooking from the shop (for now)

You now receive a gift when you max out relationship with a character, which you display on your bedroom shelf. 

New researches to unlock!

Dungeon inhabitants now get tired when you beat them in training. (Wouldn't you?)

Match 3 now has difficulty settings. You can set it to Standard (default), Easier, and Skip Match3

New tooltips for the inventory screen to say what your stuff does!

You can now visit the Lich, but only when you have permission

New items to be gifted during the late game daily conversations

Recipes in reference to rowan_of_waterdeep and FieryAshes

So many new motes for daily challenges, dates and abilities

 Changes: 

The Forging minigame has new graphics and a better help graphic

Typos and grammatical errors caught and collected 

The clock is finally animated!

More puzzles will now display the objective on turn 1

Lich will now poof away rather than just vanishing

Journal has a new look

 Bug fixes: 

Puzzles should no longer appear off the side of the screen

Jett's hangouts will no longer just hang

Fixed a lot of bugs from the steam forums (thanks for posting those!

The game is so massive now that our small team is simply unable to test every iteration of everything, so there will probably be a lot of typos and bugs towards the end of the game. We'll be watching the forums and fixing as much as we can, but we also need a bit of a break. Thanks for bearing with us, and we hope you enjoy Matchmaker Dungeon Heart <3

notes.title: Full Release incoming!
notes.notes:
Hello Matchmakers!
It's been a little while, so we just wanted to drop by with a quick update.

We're very close to the 1.0 release of the game! 
We're currently implementing the finale of the story, as well as polishing up as much as we can for this massive milestone. We're expecting it to release sometime in June.

We've got more deep and meaningful conversations, new minigames and some new locations coming in this update too, here's a little preview of one.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44560074/587915a75ef41db7808f5ddc72b6f467771b7043.png

When we do fully release, we're going to try to do a big push on socials and with influencers. If you'd be willing to leave us a steam review once 1.0 comes out, that'd be hugely helpful.

-Ghost Moth

notes.title: Cut the Smalltalk update is out!
notes.notes:
Hello Matchmakers!

We're bringing you a massive update in the first minutes of December!

The big ticket item for this version are the new talking animations! The datable characters are so much more expressive now, and we love how they look. Huge shout out to our artist and programmer that got all of these working in the span of just 1 month!

In addition to this, we've seen the comments about our typos, spelling and grammatical errors, and we got pretty embarrassed. So, we made a new workflow and we've identified and corrected over 300 of them. (ːsteamfacepalmː so many...)
There will still be some lingering in our massive script, but hopefully the dramatically reduced occurrences  will put some of you at ease.

Lastly, we've got new content to spice up your daily dungeon life, and support for a few different screen sizes. We're still working on steam deck resolution, but hopefully we'll have a lot more supported sizes in our full release.

Thanks for reading these and following along with our development. Our next major update is unlikely to release in December will all the features we were hoping, but we're trying our best to get this game completed. Patch notes below, happy matching!
-Ghost Moth

(I think this is some kind of imp soup heist?)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44560074/917897d433c8de71cdbc76b780e8672b878c6c20.png 
Version 1.6.0 Patch notes
Added:

All boss fights now have a second fight, including the new boss!
Datable characters now talk with their mouths, blink, and idle around!
 New boss has unique music track and sound effects
Gave multiple combatants blocking moves so they can stay in fights a bit longer (and pressure you to attack or use anti-block assists)
Spirits that change how you play each day based on their mood
A dungeon activity to appease the spirits
An animated title screen background based on your last location!
Windowed and Fullscreen support
Support for three 16:9 screen resolutions


Changes:

Fixed 305 text errors in the script
Eldoris' chance attacks are now a bit more likely to deal damage
Consumable items in the vault are significantly cheaper than before
Increased relationship points given by combat reward (1->3)
Temporal Bloom research cost reduced (999 gold -> 200 gold, still hard to get with the current content, but more achievable long-term)
 Hid the dungeon entrance from the map because there was no reason to go there
 Buffs and Debuffs now pulse when they are triggered
 If you acquire a spell or an item while you have empty slots, they are automatically equipped
 All obstacle motes can now be cleared using column, row and area clear motes.


Bug fixes:

Increasing friendship with Eldoris will no longer increase friendship with Konstantina for no reason
Opponent healing and blocking now appear on the correct side of the matchmaker
Journal fills in completed hearts properly
Eldoris' Binding Gift attack will no longer soft-lock combat if it tries to replace itself
Some soft locks that occurred during daily/date dialogue fixed
 Calyx's cooking challenge will now succeed if you do it right, and fail if you do it wrong (it did the opposite before, oops)

notes.title: Version 1.5.1,
notes.notes:
Hello Matchmakers!

The imps have finalised the touches on the latest shipment of fixes, balance and improvements. We noticed AJ was quite the challenge in the early game, so we're slowing down his crushing strike attack just enough to allow you to find some extra focus. We're always keeping an eye on the forums and making adjustments based on feedback, so feel free to make suggestions on improvements and balance, we'll see it and likely do something about it. 

As a little update on how we're tracking, the team is currently working at full speed to increase the game's content and features for the next major update. We've also recorded all but a few characters voice acting, and we're preparing to reveal our voice cast over the next few months, so stay tuned on our socials to catch those before anyone else.

As always, full change list is below. Enjoy v1.5.1, and enjoy another imp art piece! (This imp is named Crumbs and he should not be on that anvil)
-Ghost Moth

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44560074/2846e786d4538c9bf13bb5355c6aede0966fbcb3.png
Version 1.5.1 Patch notes
Added:

You can now look at a mote's tooltip by holding right click.
New puzzle music, and a new sound effect for scouting
New scouting dialogue for the new commanders, and the new invasion targets!
Locked status now displays turns remaining in tooltip
Added a tooltip to the tooltip button (I heard you liked help so I added some help to your help)


Changes:

Nerfed AJ's Crushing Strike turns (2 -> 3)
Blocking moves now set the characters block to the value, rather than adding (to prevent massive block totals)
Nerfed Daybreak's Reinforce turns (1 -> 3) and amount of block gained (30 -> 20)
Buffed the "Increase MaxHP" combat reward (1 -> 3)
Oren's Solo Spotlight matchmaker effect now goes away if Oren's mote is cleared early.
Buffed the Ice Breaker research to chain clearing the frozen status (looks cool)
Nerfed the Trance Breaker research, only goes into effect when you take damage (before it was when you were hit, even if you blocked)
Changed how burning status spreads so it is less chance based. Should result in less fires
Hidden status now fully hides mote underneath, and the tooltip explanation is clearer
Changed wording for all status effect tooltips to make their end condition clearer
Changed wording for Passive Bone and Sorcery Multiply buffs
Changed wording for Sweet Spot item
Changed some of commander Gleam's dialogue (to match with future VO)
Fixed up some oddities in AJ's first hangout
Updated stun status given by Exalted Bolt


Bug fixes:

You can now trigger Philomela's placeholder hangout, advance her friendship, and unlock her assist/research!
Fixed bug with Konstantina's "Make an Opening" assist, no longer fills the matchmaker with junk
Eldoris' daily conversations should now end naturally
The Ancient Secrets research no longer breaks combat (and has a new sprite)
Colour Combo research now actually adds the combo damage
Several tutorial battles refactored for clarity, and to prevent incorrect end states
Number pop-ups during battles now include buffs/debuffs that provide passive healing/focus, and use the correct total if modified

notes.title: The Dreams and Schemes update is here!
notes.notes:
Hello Matchmakers!

The Dreams and Schemes update is now live! The imps have been working their hardest to take the game to new heights. You can find a list of patch notes below about all the exciting new content you can find in Dungeon Heart.

The biggest highlights are obviously all the new assets! We've got imp portraits, new sprites for the matchmaker, new daily conversations (especially with AJ and Vanora), bonus puzzles to play, secrets and more!
If you want to see as much new content as possible, starting a new save file is probably a good idea.

We're also preparing for a lot of steam events coming up, including a discount for the game which will be going live soon. If you're going to be at PAX Australia, come say hi! We've got some merch, and we'll be selling the game there to.

We're on track with our roadmap, so while there will certainly be an update between November and now, we have a lot more in store in the next major update.

Enjoy! - Ghost Moth

notes.title: Version 1.4.1, that's a hot fix.
notes.notes:
Hello Matchmakers!

We've noticed that the imps have seemingly caused a lot of chaos within our game, so we've given them cute little construction outfits, and put them to work clearing up their messes.

Our team has been hard at work fine tuning and tweaking the elements already in the game.
We've also begun cooking on our first major update, so lots of new content is on the way.

Below you can find the full list of changes and bugfixes, we hope you like the refined v1.4.1!
-Ghost Moth

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44560074/e3c747fae3543587f13059b9984ba9fbb94067c8.png

Version 1.4.1 Patch notes
-Added daily conversations with Jett on days 4, 5 and 7 (if ze is in the tavern).
-Research areas open up after advancing your relationship to tier 2 (formally tier 3).
-Auto-letterboxing has been added as a temporary fix for different screen resolutions.
-Reduced default ambience volume.
-Oren now has his own training defeat lines (and is no longer borrowing Jett’s).
-Added sound effects to the Lone Bone assist.
-Exhaustion debuff has updated icon.

Bug Fixes:
-Talking to Oren more than once in a day will no longer require a soft reset.
-AJ’s stance break will now break sparking motes correctly.
-AJ’s parry will now only block might attacks.
-Spells can no longer be cast when stunned or at 0 magic.
-Fixed a layering issue that hid the icon for the Lone Bone assist.
-Fixed an inventory of 11+ items overflowing the wrong way.
-The audio effects for spells should now line up more accurately with the animations.
-Spells with variable costs will no longer break combat.
-Various spelling and typo fixes (Especially for Calyx, those imps would not leave them alone).
